textTemplates.name: SVC_FraudAwarenessTipsScript
textTemplates.text:
{!SVC_GetContact.FirstName}, please take note of the following tips to safeguard you against fraudulent transactions in the future

  • Review your account statements on a timely basis and query disputed transactions with the bank immediately
  • When shopping online, only place orders with your card on a secure website and only deal with reputable companies
  • Do not send emails that quote your full card number, expiry date or CVC ( the last three digits on the back of your card)
  • Never share personal and confidential information with strangers over the phone and also note that the bank will never ask you to confirm your confidential information over the phone.
  • Do not click on links or icons in emails or SMSs - delete those immediately
  • We will never phone, email or SMS to ask for your OTP or ATM pin
